title: init-project-context Phase 1 discovery output
description: Intermediate emitted by Phase 1 (Discovery) of /init-project-context. Phase 2 (Deep analysis) consumes it. The four stacks.* keys and three entryPoints.* keys are always present; absent stacks set detected=false with empty evidence.

rootPath.description: Absolute path to the scanned project root, normalised to str(Path.cwd()).

scannedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which discovery completed. Optional but recommended for audit.

notes.description: Free-form diagnostic strings (e.g. "skipped Interface/legacy/ — exceeded soft deadline"). Optional.

pathArray.description: Repo-relative paths with forward-slash separators. Sorted lexicographically; runs over the same tree must be byte-identical.

authMode.description: Literal value of the <authentication mode="..."> attribute when present (typically "Forms" for AutoClone-family repos). null if no <authentication> element was found in any Web.config.
